items.title: Kyrgyzstan deports Russian blogger accused of recruiting locals for Ukraine war

items.title: Kyrgyzstan Urges Citizens in Russia to Exercise Caution Following Drone Attacks on Wildberries Warehouses

items.title: Kyrgyz President says China–Kyrgyzstan–Uzbekistan railway will transform country into major transit hub
items.titleNl: De president van Kirgizië zegt dat de spoorweg China-Kirgizië-Oezbekistan het land zal transformeren in een belangrijk transitoknooppunt

items.title: China Launches Beijing-Bishkek Flights as Kyrgyzstan-China Links Grow
items.titleNl: China Lanceert vluchten Peking-Bishkek naarmate de verbindingen tussen Kirgizië en China groeien
